def transform(grid):
    # Largest colored object; output its strict interior (object minus border).
    from collections import deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col == 0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((len(cells),col,cells))
    _,col,cells=max(comps)
    s=set(cells)
    inner={(r,c) for r,c in cells if all((r+dr,c+dc) in s for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))}
    if not inner: return [[col]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in inner); r1=max(r for r,c in inner)
    c0=min(c for r,c in inner); c1=max(c for r,c in inner)
    return [[col if (r,c) in inner else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
